credits.title: Elsewhere
credits.overview: Two women meet, wander and experience together a city that unveils different places and a connection beyond them.

credits.title: Videotape
credits.overview: Carolina and Elsa, two friends of 10 and 13 years old who live in the same housing unit, enjoy a childhood full of mischief, video recordings and pop music in the nineties.

credits.title: Velvet
credits.overview: Ale and her best friend Rubén, witness the brief sighting of a comet. She hangs on to the moment.

credits.title: Rock Hours
credits.overview: After Elena suffered an accident, her father Anselmo is forced to take care of her. Despite not having a very good relationship they will be immersed in a coexistence that will change their emotional bond.

credits.title: Lupulos' House
credits.overview: An emotional journey that takes us into one father – daughter relationship, through their struggles and dificultéis, ending in the house by the sea where they were happy together.

credits.title: Carina
credits.overview: Carina is 8 and likes rock & roll. Her life changes completely when she believes that her new teacher is the same woman she saw in a her father’s erotic magazine.
